title: solar.terrain.surface/1 (DRAFT for review)
description: A triangulated ground surface (TIN) in the same metric Cartesian frame as a Module 01 layout, with an explicit vertical reference. Structural checks only; semantic rules (counter-clockwise triangles, no plan overlap, no duplicate plan vertices, positive triangle area, limits) are listed in CONTRACTS.md section 2 and enforced by the validator.

frame.description: Identical object to the Module 01 request frame. Terrain and layout frames must be equal; no horizontal transformation is performed.

vertical.description: Vertical reference of every z value. Required; there is no default and no transformation between vertical references.

crs.description: Vertical CRS identifier (e.g. EPSG:5773) for orthometric/ellipsoidal heights; null for a local datum.

id.description: Identifier of a local benchmark datum; required when kind = local.

triangles.description: Vertex index triples, counter-clockwise in plan. Coverage is exactly the closed union of these triangles; there is no implicit triangulation.
